correctness.rationale: The Poisson exponential backward age A at stationarity and V0|A∼N(0,2DA) give Laplace density κ exp(-κ|v|)/2 with κ=√(r/D). Conditional on future reset interval lengths ℓ_j summing to T, the increment X_T=L V0+G, L=ℓ_1 and G independent centered normal with variance (2D/3)∑ℓ_j³. For c=κ/T all partitions satisfy e^{cx}P(X_T>x|partition)≤exp(Dc²∑ℓ³/3)≤exp(rT/3); if any future reset L<T, the c-weighted tail tends to zero, while on no reset L=T its limit is exp(rT/3)/2. Dominated convergence and P(no reset)=exp(-rT) give constant exp(-2rT/3)/2 and conditional no-reset posterior→1. The MGF denominator κ²-θ²L² and positive-probability L=T event prove its exact finite domain |θ|<κ/T and boundary coefficient exp(-2rT/3). Stationary covariance (2D/r)exp(-r|t|) yields Var X_T=(4D/r³)(rT-1+exp(-rT)). Independent convolution numerics matched the tail constant for three parameter sets; universal asymptotic follows analytically.
